title: Description length boundary: exactly 20 characters is accepted, 19 is rejected
steps: POST /bug-reports with a description of exactly 20 characters
POST /bug-reports with a description of exactly 19 characters
expectedResult: The 20-character request returns 201; the 19-character request returns 400, confirming the isLength({min:20}) boundary is inclusive at 20.

title: Status badge colors match the BUG_STATUSES config (Open=blue, In Progress=orange, Closed=green)
steps: View the ticket table with at least one ticket in each of the three statuses
expectedResult: Open renders a blue badge, In Progress an orange badge, Closed a green badge — matching both the table column render() and the drawer's status section.

title: Ticket column falls back to jiraKey when ticketNumber is missing, and shows '—' when both are absent
description: The Ticket column render() evaluates `record.ticketNumber || record.jiraKey` and returns '—' only if neither exists — since ticketNumber is always generated at creation time in the current code path, this mainly guards against legacy/malformed records.
steps: View a record with ticketNumber set
View a (seeded/legacy) record with ticketNumber null but jiraKey set
View a record with both null
expectedResult: First row shows the ticketNumber; second row shows the jiraKey instead; third row shows '—'.

title: Pagination control only appears when total ticket count exceeds 10
description: SupportPage renders <Pagination> only when `total > 10`, regardless of the current page size selection.
steps: View /support for an org/user with <= 10 total tickets
View /support for an org/user with 11+ total tickets
expectedResult: Pagination is hidden in the first case and visible with correct page count in the second case.

title: A user without bug-report.read_all sees only a single unlabeled ticket list, never the tab control
steps: Log in as the permission-less user and open /support
expectedResult: No 'My Tickets' / 'All Tickets' Tabs component is rendered at all (canReadAll is falsy, so the entire Tabs Box is conditionally omitted) — the page goes straight to the filter bar and table, scoped to the user's own tickets.
